acceptanceCriteria: An append-only, bounded, secret-screened ticket note verb exists, recorded in the journal with its author and time and shown by ticket show.
Notes are not inputs to eligibility, gates or completion.
Spec requirements and maintained tests cover append, replay idempotence by request ID, and the size bound.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Source: read-only rc.3 accuracy survey 2026-10-06 (origin/main 3dc863bd, installed rc.2 build 360) replaying merged PRs 571, 614, 594, 557, 610 at their merge-base. Harness and outputs: /private/tmp/claude-501/td-survey (local, not retained in the repository). corvint-tasks has no note or comment command. Agents recording evidence on an open ticket must refine the whole payload, which risks overwriting concurrent edits and makes the evidence history hard to read.
title: corvint-tasks: no verb to append evidence notes to a ticket; evidence goes into refine re-writes
